rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for casting a vote or choosing in an election.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 tau4 piu3

rows.note: Use this in formal meetings or institutions when a motion or question is decided by vote.

example.english: The committee will vote on the motion.
example.traditional: 委員會將就項動議進行表決。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui6 zoeng1 zau6 hong6 dung6 ji5 zeon3 hang4 biu2 kyut3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or instance of voting, rather than the formal decision itself.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 tau4 piu3

rows.note: Use this for a formal vote or decision on a motion, appointment, or legal matter.

example.english: The committee will hold a formal vote on this appointment.
example.traditional: 委員會將就呢項任命進行表決。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui6 zoeng1 zau6 ni1 hong6 jam6 ming6 zeon3 hang4 biu2 kyut3

rows.note: Use this for one individual counted vote or ballot, especially when stressing how many votes someone has cast.

example.english: I cast one vote for him this time.
example.traditional: 我今次投咗一票支持佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 tau4 zo2 jat1 piu3 zi1 ci4 keoi5
